description: Grep one known dependency class's source for a string, identifier, or pattern (literal; regex optional). Unknown class: search_classes. Whole JAR: search_in_artifact.

className.description: FQN, e.g. com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; a unique simple name works.

modulePath.description: Gradle path like ':app', or a file/dir inside the module. Omit (or "*") for all modules.

projectRoot.description: Project root. Omit to use the workspace.

query.description: Text to find in the class source (literal; regex if regex=true).

name: find_in_class_source
title: Find text in resolved Java source
